headline: Heavy Clashes Erupt In Mooring County And Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Fresh fighting has ignited across northern and central sectors over the past three hours, led by a sudden flare-up in Mooring County where eight strategic base shifts occurred around The Wind Hills. In Callahan's Passage, grinding attrition gave way to direct territorial contest, logging four base events around Crumbling Post alongside more than three thousand combined casualties in the latest two-hour interval. Linn of Mercy continues its fierce struggle, registering five additional base exchanges over the past two hours across contested positions at Rotdust, Lathair, and Outwich Ranch. Weathered Expanse remains actively contested with two fresh shifts and heavy losses, leaving three bases reduced to neutral ruins. Meanwhile, Nevish Line continues to absorb punishing casualties exceeding two thousand dead in two hours despite seeing no line movement since earlier in the morning. Stonecradle and the southern reaches remain broadly quiet, with strategic activity confined strictly to the active northern salients.
